  491|                try:
  492|                    mtime = path.stat().st_mtime
  493|                except OSError:
  494|                    continue
  495|                if now - mtime > ROLLOUT_FILE_LOOKBACK_SECONDS:
  496|                    continue

  498|                # Rollouts without terminal markers from before the current
  499|                # app-server epoch are crash evidence, not live concurrency.
  500|                if desktop_started_at is not None and mtime < desktop_started_at:
  501|                    continue

  503|                if not meta or not meta.get("id"):
  504|                    continue

  507|        # live parent in both passes creates an avoidable race where a newly
  508|        # appended task_started/task_complete changes the classification
  509|        # halfway through the same dashboard sample.
  510|        terminal_by_path = {
  511|            str(item["path"]): rollout_terminal(item["path"])
  512|            for item in sessions.values()
  513|        }
  514|        candidates: dict[str, list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}

  518|            parent_id = meta.get("parent_thread_id")
  519|            if not parent_id:
  520|                continue
  521|            parent = sessions.get(str(parent_id))
  522|            if not parent:
  523|                continue

  525|            # Child rollout activity is therefore equally valid evidence that
  526|            # this parent group belongs to the current live task.
  527|            group_activity = max(float(parent["mtime"]), float(item["mtime"]))
  528|            if now - group_activity > ROLLOUT_PARENT_FRESH_SECONDS:
  529|                continue
  530|            if (terminal_by_path.get(str(parent["path"]), False)
  531|                    or terminal_by_path.get(str(path), False)):
  532|                continue
  533|            source = meta.get("source") if isinstance(meta.get("source"), dict) else {}
  534|            subagent = source.get("subagent") if isinstance(source.get("subagent"), dict) else {}
  535|            spawn = subagent.get("thread_spawn") if isinstance(subagent.get("thread_spawn"), dict) else {}

  537|            explicit_role = meta.get("agent_role") or spawn.get("agent_role")
  538|            candidates.setdefault(str(parent_id), []).append({
  539|                "agent_id": agent_id,
  540|                "parent_session_id": str(parent_id),
  541|                "name": read_rollout_task_name(path),
  542|                "role": explicit_role or "agent",
  543|                "agent_role_explicit": bool(explicit_role),
  544|                "model": meta.get("model") or model_profile.get("active_turn_model", ""),
  545|                **model_profile,
  546|                "cwd": meta.get("cwd") or parent["meta"].get("cwd"),
  547|                "updated_at": float(item["mtime"]),
  548|                "created_at": rollout_created_at(path, meta),
  549|                "recent_activity": now - float(item["mtime"]) <= ROLLOUT_ACTIVE_SECONDS,
  550|            })
  551|            newest = max(newest or 0.0, float(parent["mtime"]), float(item["mtime"]))
  552|        tasks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
  553|        open_sessions = 0
  554|        for parent_id, rows in candidates.items():
  555|            parent = sessions.get(parent_id)
  556|            group_activity = max(
  557|                ([float(parent["mtime"])] if parent else [0.0])
  558|                + [float(row.get("updated_at", 0) or 0) for row in rows])

  572|            tasks.extend(sorted(rows, key=lambda row: float(row.get("created_at", 0))))

  580|def desktop_app_server_started_at(now: float | None = None) -> float | None:
  581|    """Return the current Windows Codex app-server process epoch, cached.
  582|
  583|    This is used only as a freshness fence for rollout fallback. Failure to
  584|    inspect processes degrades to the previous behavior; it never changes
  585|    lifecycle state or stops a process.

  587|    now = time.time() if now is None else now
  588|    if now - float(_desktop_epoch_cache.get("checked_at", 0.0) or 0.0) < 10.0:
  589|        return _desktop_epoch_cache.get("value")
  590|    value = None
